notes.title: Hotfix 1.23
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has purchased and played Caretaker! 
A few issues have come up in the past week that we wanted to address. 

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with games not saving, this was due to our play button being the incorrect button
[*] Filled in a small gap where players could get stuck in the flowey room
[*] Adjusted a splotlight in the flowey room based on dominant player behaviour 
[/list]

Thank you again everyone! 
Cheers from Fuzzy Logic

notes.title: Caretaker Beta Update
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the latest beta update for Caretaker, packed with new content and enemies! Dive into new adventures with 7 exciting new areas that expand the world like never before. 

Our newest section, the Outback has new puzzles, mechanics enemies and more!

We have also done a major overhaul to our Jungle Gym area making it a smoother and easier to understand experience.

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to our release.

Check out our latest trailer here!
[previewyoutube=7IA5Fi0kJhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
